description: Ten brand-new Frost Mages, one per model, in one world for an hour: three sizes each of Claude, GPT and Gemini, and DeepSeek, all on opencode through OpenRouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY), so the model is the only thing that differs. Same class, spec and start for everyone; neutral character names, so no one can tell from chat who is which model. Compare with `azbench compare`.
